pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal Pretreatment (HTP) was conducted in a 1000 mL stainless-steel autoclave reactor (WZC-1000) with a Teflon lining. The total volatile solids (VS) concentration was set at 30 g VS·L^-1, with a FW-to-Enteromorpha ratio of 3:1 on a VS basis. Fresh Enteromorpha and FW were pulverized to approximately 0.25 mm and less than 0.21 mm respectively using a hammer mill (YSW-180, Zhengde, China). Impurities such as bones, plastic bags, and plastic cups were removed from the FW. Oyster shells, collected from Binhai New Area, Tianjin, China, were added to a total dry weight of 8% (w/w) of FW and Enteromorpha to strengthen the system, stabilize pH, and improve the performance of DF. The moisture content was adjusted to 90% using deionized water. The reactor was heated to 50, 80, 110, or 140 °C and maintained for 20 min. The HTP process was carried out to enhance digestion performance and obtain higher bioenergy efficiency, with chemical-free nature and environment-friendly nature noted.

Oyster shells (collected from Binhai New Area, Tianjin, China) were pulverized to less than 0.21 mm using a hammer mill (YSW-180, Zhengde, China). They were added to the total dry weight of FW and Enteromorpha at 8% (w/w) of the total dry weight. This addition was performed to strengthen the system, stabilize pH, and improve the performance of DF, ensuring suitable buffering capacity for hydrogen generation during anaerobic digestion.

Mechanical degradation (grinding/milling) was performed on substrates during sample preparation. The FW was milled using a food grinder (Element40, BECBAS, China), with bones, plastic bags, and plastic cups removed. Fresh Enteromorpha was collected from the seaside of Laoshan District, Qingdao, Shandong, China, air-dried, then pulverized to approximately 0.25 mm using a hammer mill (YSW-180, Zhengde, China). Oyster shells were pulverized to less than 0.21 mm using a hammer mill (YSW-180, Zhengde, China). This mechanical degradation was necessary to ensure the substrates were suitable for anaerobic digestion.
